name: smolvla_vision_seg
_comment: 49-tile whole-segment cut. No tile reaches HTA (no Hta.bin exists for a whole segment), so this is CPU/DSP only -- but 49 contexts fit under the ~56 the board tolerates, so they stay resident and pay no per-tile load. The A/B against the 141-tile hybrid is scheduling gain vs context-bringup cost.
